content.title: The Amendment that REDEFINED freedom: The 14th amendment
content.text: We break down the 14th Amendment in clear, simple terms - from its origins after the Civil War to how it still shapes modern America today. We cover: Citizenship Clause Due Process Clause Equal Protection Clause Why the 14th Amendment is at the center of major Supreme Court cases Whether you're a student, curious about U.S. history, or just want to understand your rights better, this video explains why the 14th Amendment continues to impact everything from civil rights to modern politics. Check out my free resources for Civics here: https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/S... Thank you to my teacher homies for supporting this channel through my TPT store!
